period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 September 2016' (the filing also separately shows a discrete 3-month column, not used here). Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (3rd_quarter_2016.pdf) is a native digital PDF; the Balance Sheet extracted cleanly, but the P&L page had the same column-alignment defect seen in the 2016_Q1/Q2 filings for the current-period deep rows, so those figures were confirmed via a 300dpi visual render: Profit before provisions 2,952,884,798 - Total provisions 890,520,146 = Profit after provision 2,062,364,652; less Contribution to NCC Bank Foundation 17,000,000 = Profit before tax 2,045,364,652; less Provision for tax 1,104,100,356 (current tax 1,133,706,898 + deferred tax income 29,606,542) = Profit after tax 941,264,296, matching the filing's own EPS of 1.07. Balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 144,338,194,382 + Total Shareholders' Equity 15,403,185,040 = Total Assets 159,741,379,422). Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2015' column (Total Assets BDT 146,369.95mn, Total Shareholders' Equity BDT 15,654.64mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2015_Q4.json exactly.
